messages:
release-bot: Starting green-shadow deploy (router v2 -> v3) in eu-west. Window 15:30-16:30 UTC. Initial traffic slice = 3% for 10m, then staged ramps to 30% over 30m. Rollback trigger: 5xx rate > 2% sustained for 3m or p95 latency +200ms relative to baseline. Logs shipped to #eng-sre-observability.
Keeley: On it — I'll own the rollout cadence and will post updates. Can we confirm config ID?
Sam: Config is `router-v3-greenshadow-2026-03-21` in the deploy manifest. BGP/edge rules unchanged.
Maria: I'm on-call for eu-west. My alert thresholds are set to align with the rollback triggers. I'll snoop latency dashboards at first ramp.
Keeley: Release notes: minor router scheduling changes + improved connection pooling. No schema or infra migrations. Adding the short note to the release doc.
Aly: FYI: Sales-facing customers on dedicated capacity were notified earlier. No pinning required for Dedicated customers — they stay on pinned versions.
Alan: Quick check: if traffic ramp fails and we cut back, will the router fallback use v2 sticky sessions? We need to ensure KV cache invalidation isn't required.
Sam: Confirmed — session affinity cookie name unchanged. Fallback goes to v2 with cache warmup via prefix cache hit priming. No invalidation needed.
Keeley: Plan: T+0 (15:30) deploy green pods, healthchecks 30s. T+5 start 3% traffic. T+15 monitor, T+25 -> 10%, T+40 -> 20%, T+60 -> 30% steady. If any rollback trigger fires we immediately cut to 0% and drain.
Jake: I'll run the step script and stand by to pin the old route if needed. `./tools/traffic-shift --router router-eu-west --to v3 --percent 3` is the initial command.
deploy-bot: running: `./tools/traffic-shift --router router-eu-west --to v3 --percent 3 --dry-run=false`
deploy-bot: step 1/5: new pods registered, healthchecks passing (ok=18/18). Starting traffic shift 3%.
Maria: Seeing 3% traffic now. No errors in logs so far. p95 baseline 120ms -> current p95 125ms.
Alan: Watch mem and connection saturation on v3 — previous tests showed slight heap bump at high conc. If we see >70% mem, we should pause.
Keeley: Noted. Monitor: p95, 5xx rate, mem %. I'll call pause if any metric drifts.
Aly: Remind infra to hold non-essential deploys during the 30m ramp window.
Sam: Holding other infra jobs in eu-west for the next 45m.
deploy-bot: ramp to 10% scheduled in 10m at 15:40 UTC.
Keeley: If the 5xx >2% at any time, immediate rollback. Alan, Jake — you're point to execute rollback procedure.
Jake: Understood. Rollback procedure: `./tools/traffic-shift --router router-eu-west --to v2 --percent 100 --grace 30` then `./tools/drain --selector v3=true`. I'll also pin v2 at router control-plane if needed.
Maria: Alert rule temporarily fired for a brief 5xx blip at 15:36 (0.8% but not sustained). Keeping watch.
Keeley: That's fine — below threshold. Continuing.
deploy-bot: T+25: ramping to 10% now.
Maria: p95 up to 140ms, 5xx steady at 0.3%. Mem on v3 at 45%.
Alan: Good margin. Continue.
Keeley: Reminder: update release doc with the exact config ID and the rollback commands so oncall can run them quickly.
Aly: Logged. Also adding note for commerce customers: no expected impact.
deploy-bot: T+40: ramping to 20%.
Maria: p95 170ms, 5xx climbed to 1.6% for 2m. Watching for sustained trend.
Keeley: If 5xx breaches 2% for 3m -> rollback. Any signs of error type?
Maria: Errors are mostly upstream timeouts to the rating service — not router code. Alerting the rating-service team now. @sam can we route retries differently during ramp to reduce cascade?
Sam: We can throttle client retries at the router side (limit to 1 retry, 100ms backoff) while we watch. Pushing small config change now.
deploy-bot: applied retry-limit patch (limit=1, backoff=100ms) to router-eu-west.
Maria: After retry-limit change, 5xx down to 0.9%. p95 back to 150ms.
Keeley: Nice. Keep ramping. Next target 30% at T+60.
Jake: Preparing rollback steps just in case — will not run unless we hit the trigger.
Alan: I'll keep an eye on memory and connection churn; will shout if >70% mem or TCP resets increase.
deploy-bot: T+60: ramp to 30% started.
Maria: p95 180ms, 5xx at 0.5%. No client-visible errors reported.
Keeley: We're golden. Proceed to steady-state. Post-deploy tasks: run small synthetic prompts, verify logs retention and trace IDs for the new route, and update the changelog with the final version.
Aly: Marking the release as "green-shadow successful" in the release tracker and notifying support channels.
keeley: Thanks everyone — closing the thread in 20m unless anyone objects. Great coordination. :tada:
